comment: Declared desired state for the IB Gateway API surface and its systemd persistence. Single source — check_ibgateway_config.py derives every expectation from here and hardcodes none of them (nix_check_contract.md §2.4, doctrine C.4). ARC 010 measured every value below against the live Gateway; see docs/CHECK-DEBT.md for what is NOT covered.
why_not_jts_ini: ARC 010 measured this: ~/Jts/jts.ini carries only TrustedIPs and AutoRestart in plaintext. The API socket port, ReadOnlyApi, the localhost-only flag and the auto-restart TIME live in the IBGZENC-encrypted settings store and cannot be parsed. jts.ini's [IBGateway] LocalServerPort=4000 is NOT the API port — it is the SSL tunnel to ndc1.ibllc.com, and a check that read a port out of jts.ini would read that one and be wrong. The API port is therefore Nix's declared state, asserted against reality, which is what doctrine A.1 asks a check to do.
